clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Flawed Power Stone rests on arcane tables, charged with arcane energy. Its makers left it fatally flawed, so it consumes its own power soon after it is moved.

In the Barrens, flawed power stones hold arcane essence within compromised structures. Their makers deliberately left them unstable, so they decay into inert matter moments after someone handles them.
A stone begins consuming its power as soon as it leaves the ritual table where it rests. Its energy burns away too quickly for anyone to carry it far.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These stones are infused with magical energy, but purposefully flawed. They are very unstable and once removed from the table they will consume themselves quickly.
